pastConcepts.title: V01 — The Door Came Free
pastConcepts.device: selfie homeowner reveal, offer as surprise
pastConcepts.notes: AI-generated woman in cream sweater films herself walking to new black-frame patio door and bay window; golden retriever cameo. Karaoke captions with green keyword. Black end card. No Al. Does not name Kentucky.

pastConcepts.title: V03 — Three-Second Window Test
pastConcepts.notes: Faceless hands-only macro on an old foggy wood window; black label cards 'PAIN POINT ONE FOG' etc.; calm male VO tells viewer to test their own window, then free consultation. Offer only on end card. No Al, no Kentucky.

pastConcepts.title: V04 — Three Companies vs One
pastConcepts.notes: AI-generated Black spokesman in gray branded button-up (garbled name tag) in a bright living room; cuts to label-box graphic, real factory line and installer b-roll; black end card with offer. Not Al. No Kentucky mention.

pastConcepts.title: V05 — Same Room, Before/After
pastConcepts.device: green swipe wipe before -> after on one window
pastConcepts.notes: Real-looking phone photos/video of an older living room (recliner, dog bed, foggy diamond-grille window) wiped to new white double-hung; a bare arm gestures. Three VO lines, offer spoken, black end card. No Al, no Kentucky.

pastConcepts.title: V08 — Jaw Hit the Floor (song)
pastConcepts.format: 3D animated brand piece, original country song
pastConcepts.device: sung story ballad: bill shock -> call -> install -> offer chorus
pastConcepts.notes: Pixar-style couple in a kitchen, branded box truck, female consultant with tablet, two-man install crew, craftsman front door. Whole offer is sung; ends 'Renewal by Andersen, Kentucky's your door' then end card. Preview length, not a cutdown. No Al.

references.title: RBA-KY_SEP26_V01-A (UGC door reveal)
references.take: Selfie-walk reveal into the product, ~2s shot rhythm, warm low sun, spoken dollar-free offer line ('got us the patio door, no charge'), karaoke captions with one green word.
references.avoid: Uncanny AI face in tight selfie framing; brand logo pinned top-centre over every shot; no Kentucky cue anywhere.

references.title: RBA-KY_SEP26_V03 (Fog/Draft/Stick)
references.take: Second-person 'go test your window' hook, hands-only macro so no avatar is needed, black label cards numbering the pain points, 4-6s unhurried shots.
references.avoid: Twenty seconds of grey, damp old-window imagery with no product or crew shown until the end card; offer never spoken.

references.title: RBA-KY_SEP26_V04 (one company)
references.take: Cut from presenter to a four-step Design/Build/Install/Service checklist that fills as real factory and install b-roll plays; warranty framed as the payoff of one accountable company.
references.avoid: AI presenter with garbled name tag and shirt logo; avoid quoting 'most window jobs pass through three companies' as fact without substantiation.

references.title: RBA-KY_SEP26_V05-UGC (before/after)
references.take: Locked-off same-angle before/after with a vertical green wipe; real lived-in room (recliner, dog bed) sells authenticity; three sentences total, offer spoken plainly.
references.avoid: Nearly static frame for 20s with only one hand in shot; end card carries all detail so the ad reads as a slideshow.

references.title: RBA-KY_SEP26_V08 preview (animated song)
references.take: Story beats that show the whole journey (bill shock, consultant with tablet, box truck, two-man install, new door) and the only ad that names Kentucky in the tag line.
references.avoid: Pixar-style 3D animation and sung offer; 73s runtime; melting logo text on the truck and polos; agency has moved off animation for this client.

references.title: Renewal Now 30 - Master (corporate spokesman)
references.take: Approved corporate claim wording and graphics (Fibrex, nation's best warranty shield with fine print, 1-year price lock, 'installation is always included'); black polo with single left-chest wordmark.
references.avoid: 2022 broadcast template look: blank lower-third bar, white-washed frosted backgrounds, generic 'call now' urgency, no offer, no region.

references.title: Renewal Now 15 - Master (corporate cutdown)
references.take: How a 30 collapses to 15 without losing Fibrex, free consultation and price-lock; shows the minimum legal footer wording.
references.avoid: Eight seconds of empty grey backgrounds and a slot for a dealer tag; the piece has no visual of the product or crew.

footage.name: EXT_DL_Day1_Bayport_Install_TimeLapse.mp4
footage.shows: Static GoPro time-lapse on a porch: crew in black polos and khakis removes an entry door with sidelights and transom, sets the new black unit; red ladder, trash bin, tools; a technician with Master Installer emblem walks past at ~1:14.

footage.shows: Interior time-lapse of the same entry-door job from the foyer: floor protection down, old door out, rough opening with view to a lake, new dark door with leaded sidelights installed, crew cleaning up.
